| Category = Chicken recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breast, [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]]
* 14 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] frozen [[cookbook:Broccoli|broccoli]]
* 10.5 oz canned cream of celery soup
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 6 oz [[cookbook:Milk|skim milk]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[cookbook:Curry Powder|curry powder]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Searing|Sear]] the cubed chicken in [[cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
# Place cooked chicken and remaining ingredients into a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]].
# Cover with [[cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] and [[Cookbook:Bake|bake]] in [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 375°F for 30 minutes.
# Serve with [[cookbook:Rice|rice]].
